notes: ## [2.0.0] - 2026-09-17  ### Added - **Atelier Client Themes**: Obsidian Atelier and Rosewater Atelier presets with a single representative splash, animated page backgrounds, themed navigation, friend list, and profile sidebar, applied directly from the preset card. - **Managed Pengu Loader runtime**: The app migrates an existing Pengu installation or downloads the official MIT-licensed v1.1.6 package automatically, then installs and updates LPT plugins under `%LOCALAPPDATA%`. - **Automatic Pengu start**: Pengu Loader launches on app start and after plugin setup through the Windows elevation prompt.  ### Fixed - **Custom background conflicts**: Applying a Riot skin or a preset with a Riot background now removes an active custom GIF, and keeps the GIF when the skin change fails. - **Profile area protection**: Themes no longer cover the top-right identity block or the Profile Overview background. - **Background picker**: The apply button stays below the skin grid and scrolls into view when a skin is selected.  ### Tests - 201 frontend and plugin tests, 1 Rust test, and a website media check pass.  ### Added - **Custom profile backgrounds**: Install static or animated PNG, JPG, WEBP, and GIF backgrounds through the bundled PenguLoader integration. - **Overview customization**: Override Mastery, Clash, Honor, banner, and profile Overview rank cards with a persistent live preview. - **Window size presets**: Switch between compact, recommended, and large layouts from Settings with monitor-aware sizing.  ### Changed - **Compact Control Center**: Rebuilt the application shell with grouped navigation, a global client status header, denser controls, and responsive layouts. - **Unified editors**: Standardized page headers, section headers, field layouts, panels, and action docks across Background, Overview, Rank, Challenge, and Settings. - **Accurate previews**: Background darkening and Overview champion icons, mastery levels, and automatic states now update directly in their previews. - **Responsive forms**: Rank, Challenge, Overview, and Settings controls now reflow cleanly in narrow windows. - **Feature priority**: Moved Background, Overview, Rank, and Challenge tools to the top of the customization workflow. - **Default window**: Increased the default workspace to 1200 x 800 with a 960 x 650 minimum size.  ### Tests - Updated profile interaction coverage for the button-based availability controls. The complete frontend suite passes with 191 tests.
